point_in_time_rule: Every feature uses only data available strictly before the target test date, and only tests dated >= history_window.start

features.name: window_days_available
features.source: coverage: max(0, (target_date - WINDOW_START).days) — how much observation window could exist for this prediction, regardless of the vehicle

features.name: history_years_observed
features.source: coverage: (target_date - first_observed_test_date).days / 365.25, or 0.0 when no prior test is observed

features.name: has_prior_test_observed
features.source: coverage: 1 if at least one prior test is observed inside the window, else 0

features.name: has_left_truncated_history
features.source: coverage: 1 if the vehicle was MOT-liable before WINDOW_START (first_use_date + FIRST_MOT_AGE_YEARS < WINDOW_START), i.e. true history plausibly exists that the window cannot observe

features.name: first_observed_test_is_not_true_first
features.source: coverage: 1 if a prior test is observed AND has_left_truncated_history — the earliest observed test cannot be the vehicle's true first MOT
